class.name: NNBTNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for all Noodle Nodes behaviour tree nodes.
class.description: Behaviour Trees are a commonly used structure that can be used to create artificial intelligence in games for the non-playable characters. A behaviour tree has a root node and under it a tree structure, where the branches of the tree define the behaviour for the AI. The utility enabled Behaviour Trees in Noodle Nodes GDExtension extend the traditional Behaviour Tree with utility functions. The Behaviour Tree nodes can be used as a regular behaviour tree, but the extended utility features allow you to add utility-based branch selection and execution of the Node Query System queries within your trees. The Behaviour Tree in Noodle Nodes GDExtension allows you to tick the tree by giving blackboard as input. This blackboard can be a dictionary that you want to use as the blackboard or the AI actor node itself. Or any other type of Variant. Or just null. The typed [NNBlackboard] resource on the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor is authoritative for [method get_blackboard_resource], [method get_blackboard], [method set_blackboard], [method has_blackboard], [method erase_blackboard] and [method get_actor]. The [Variant] passed to [method NNBTRoot.tick] remains legacy user data / actor and is never consulted by these helpers. With no [NNBTRoot] ancestor the helpers return their default value, [code]false[/code] or [code]null[/code] without reporting errors. [NNBTNodeReference] resolves these helpers from its target's own position in the tree.

method.name: erase_blackboard
method.description: Erases [param key] from the blackboard of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor. Returns [code]false[/code] when the key is absent or when there is no root.

method.name: get_actor
method.description: Returns the actor resolved by the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor, or [code]null[/code] when there is no root.

method.name: get_blackboard
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key] in the blackboard of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor. Returns [param default_value] when the key is missing, its value is [code]null[/code], or there is no root.

method.name: get_blackboard_resource
method.description: Returns the [NNBlackboard] resource of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor, or [code]null[/code] when there is no root.

method.name: get_tree_root
method.description: Returns a relative node path to the furthest direct [NNBTNodes] ancestor.

method.name: has_blackboard
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param key] exists in the blackboard of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor and its value is not [code]null[/code]; returns [code]false[/code] otherwise, including when there is no root.

method.name: set_blackboard
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] in the blackboard of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor. Returns [code]false[/code] when the key is empty or there is no root.

members.member: Used with Utility-based Behaviour Tree nodes. This defines how the [NNConsideration] nodes (assigned as child nodes of the behaviour tree node) are evaluated to calculate the score for the node.
The current internal status of the node, useful for debugging and seeing how the execution progresses. The following choices are possible: "Unticked:0,Ticked:1,Completed:2".
Defines how the Behaviour Tree node is reset. The following choices are possible: "WhenTicked:0,WhenCompleted:1,WhenTickedAfterBeingCompleted:2,Never:3".
The score this node received from the Utility-based evaluation.
